answer: A Translation bundle passing automated tests backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the translation bundle is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A glacier that appears twice is the tell: the same work cannot earn two identities. The cedar hides nothing and the saffron reveals everything: the review trail is open to all.
